description: Text-command parser comparison on the drone's Jetson Orin Nano: 95 labeled sentences (cases.json), 3 fresh-process runs per model in alternating order, greedy decoding with a JSON-schema grammar, prompt clock fixed, vision stream off. parse_ms = wall time of one VoiceCommandParser.parse call. mem_available_drop_mb = drop in /proc/meminfo MemAvailable over the model load (a lower bound: memory-mapped weights in page cache are not counted). Model output text is not included.

platform.board: Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB developer kit (Super)

deviations: A CPU-only test-suite run on the same board overlapped most of gemma4-03 (21:58:12-21:59:53); its accuracy is kept and its latency is excluded from the latency summary.
